title: tastewatch digest: 2026-10-07
description:
tastewatch weekly digest — 2026-10-07 (first patrol; window 2026-09-30..2026-10-07). 4 commits merged on main; all 4 audited (<5 threshold). All four are .warren config changes to the patrol infrastructure itself; zero touch repo source.

## 1. Verdict table
| sha | subject | verdict | article |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16e9a76 | chore(warren): configure triggers, feature loops… | DIVERGES | I (scope: silent defaultModel change; unpinned image) |
| f474c5d | chore: remove project model overrides (#3) | conforms | I (diff matches title exactly) |
| 98b8a85 | chore(warren): stagger automatic trigger minute | DIVERGES | I + V (title claims a change that is not in the diff) |
| 14610ee | chore(warren): remove repo agent image override (#5) | conforms | I (1-line removal, matches title) |

## 2. Divergence rate
2/4 = 50% this week. First digest; no last-week baseline (state this week's 50% as the baseline for trend comparison).

## 3. Most important divergence — 98b8a85 (Article I, V)
'chore(warren): stagger automatic trigger minute' contains zero behavioral change: all five cron expressions in .warren/triggers.yaml are byte-identical before/after (e.g. 4c89c94..dd79088, '0 4 * * *' unchanged). The only diff is comment rewrites. Worse, the new comments assert a property the file does not have: '# minute 00, staggered by project' while every entry fires at minute 00. A title and in-file memory claiming an effect that was never produced is exactly the narration noise Article V bans — future agents will read 'staggered by project' as ground truth. If staggering was intended, the change was never made; if not, the title and comments are lies about the system.

## 4. Auditor-population precision check
gatewatch: 0 seeds filed, 0 fixed, 0 wontfix, 0 open — precision n/a (no observations). ratchetwatch: same, 0/0/0/0 — n/a. Note: both patrols have been armed since 16e9a76 (2026-09-30) with daily crons, so 7+ runs should have occurred; zero seeds is consistent with a clean repo but should be re-checked next week — silent auditors are indistinguishable from dead ones.

## 5. Proposed gate (Article IX — proposal only)
Evidence: 16e9a76 silently downgraded a digest-pinned agent image (ghcr.io/nacosolutions/senshac-warren-agent@sha256:5f44b7...) to ghcr.io/rogernavelsaker/warren-agent:latest under a 'chore… configure triggers' title, and separately changed defaultModel to a :floor:low variant neither mentioned. Config-only changes are currently unreviewable by any gate. Proposed gate bin/gate-warren-config.sh, run in CI on any .warren/ change: (a) yaml-parse .warren/*.yaml; (b) reject mutable tags — agentImage must match '@sha256:' or an explicit allowlist file .warren/allowlist; (c) fail if a cron's declared minute/hour contradicts its trailing comment. This would have caught the image unpins before merge and would make the 98b8a85 comment/field mismatch impossible.

## 6. Trajectory
Drifting — 75% of the week's merges were unwinds or rewrites of 16e9a76 (f474c5d and 14610ee delete lines it added; 98b8a85 rewrites comments it added), the standing mandate docs/CONSTITUTION.md is absent (tracked separately as P1), and the patrol layer has no mechanical gate of its own.
